comment: Specs allowed to retry beyond the default because they depend on flaky infrastructure (live backend round trips, engine-specific paint timing). Every entry needs a reason and must also call allowTransientRetries() in the spec. Anything NOT listed here that goes flaky fails the job via scripts/assert-no-flaky.mjs.
